This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Imperial Decree (V) (Virtual Set 0, Original)]] (version 2 of 3). The current text is [[Imperial Decree (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[Imperial Decree (V) (Virtual Set 0, Original)]]): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 0 release<ref name="eh1351-decree-0">[https://www.scribd.com/document/248869355/Star-Wars-CCG-Virtual-Card-Base-Set Players Committee, Virtual Set 0 Base Set, 2014, Dark Side Effect sheet, p. 4 (public mirror)].</ref>. Dated 2014 (Virtual Set 0); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of Imperial Decree (V) (Virtual Set 0, Original) first published|section=On what day were the early Virtual Modern card versions first published?}} Text: “Deploy on table. At start of your turn, may lose 1 Force to activate this turn using [Light Side Force] instead of [Dark Side Force]. Whenever you lose Force (except from Force drains, battle damage, or your card), may reduce loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of battlegrounds you occupy. (Immune to Alter.)” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee Official Errata list<ref name="eh1351-decree-1">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dXwBAYCUyBvWHpZc-oSCedmOZUb5f9vSDzUdvV2dUTY/export?format=csv Players Committee, Official Errata list, Imperial Decree (V), 3 October 2015].</ref>. First published 3 October 2015. The PC card image with this text and the “E” mark is in the Holotable repository by 8 July 2018 (commit 022435b). Text: “Deploy on table. Whenever you lose Force (except from Force drains, battle damage, or your card), may reduce loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of battlegrounds you occupy. During battle, may place this Effect out of play to draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “During battle, may place this Effect out of play to draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. [Immune”, “]”; words removed: “. At start of your turn, may lose 1 Force to activate this turn using [Light Side Force] instead of [Dark Side Force]”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Imperial Decree (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-decree-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/imperialdecree.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “Deploy on table. Whenever you lose Force (except from Force drains, battle damage, or your card), may reduce loss (to a minimum of 1) by the number of battlegrounds you occupy. During battle, may place this Effect out of play to draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. [Immune to Alter.]” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”). It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.

== Source formats ==
The 2015 errata retained the loss-reduction clause, removed the activation switch and added a battle-destiny option. The wording in the 2018 full-card image already appears on the August 2016 slip.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Players Committee, Set 0, official text as of 1 August 2016, p. 6].</ref>
